candidates.concept: A returning village caretaker stops at a ridge footpath where wind moves a straw boundary rope and every open gate behind her faces the same empty field.
At a closed communal well, a village archivist finds fresh wet footprints crossing outward from the sealed lid while residents watch from separate doorways.
At dusk, a village boundary keeper has almost repaired a broken straw threshold line while silent residents wait on the other side and the open road behind her darkens.
An adult visitor misses the last rural bus as village elders turn every household lantern toward a single unoccupied chair at the roadside shelter.
A harvest volunteer notices that the villagers have set a meal for one more person than the seats can hold beside a field-edge shrine.
At a village ford, an adult resident pauses beside a dry line of carefully paired shoes whose owners stand barefoot across the water facing inland.
